article.hook: You hesitate to enjoy comfort without guilt. Chiron in Taurus makes the ache of deserving simple pleasures impossible to ignore.
article.lived: This transit stretches across years, carving a slow groove in how we relate to security and pleasure. We notice the pause before taking a bite of food, the second thought on spending money or resting. In daily life, it looks like holding back on buying a coat you actually need or delaying a moment of calm because it feels undeserved. The wound is collective but personal, a shared hesitation around feeling solid enough to relax into the body and its wants.
article.turn: The gift of patience turns to stubborn self-denial when you refuse the relief you need, wearing scarcity like armor. You don’t heal feeling unworthy by proving toughness through deprivation. You heal by claiming the right to feel safe and enjoy what’s yours without apology.
moves: Buy one thing that feels indulgent and use it without guilt this week.
Make a list of small comforts you denied yourself and pick one to try.
Say no to one demand that threatens your calm or security.
